description: This file implements the CursorInputMapper class and related components for handling cursor and pointer input events in the Android input system, including processing raw events, managing device parameters, and generating input notifications.

classes.name: CursorMotionAccumulator
classes.description: Accumulates relative cursor motion events, specifically handling REL_X and REL_Y events.

classes.name: CursorInputMapper
classes.description: Maps raw input events to higher-level cursor and pointer input notifications, managing device parameters, state, and event processing.

methods.name: CursorMotionAccumulator::CursorMotionAccumulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the accumulator and clearing relative axes.

methods.name: CursorMotionAccumulator::reset
methods.description: Resets the accumulator state for a new input device context.

methods.name: CursorMotionAccumulator::clearRelativeAxes
methods.description: Clears the stored relative X and Y movement values.

methods.name: CursorMotionAccumulator::process
methods.description: Processes a raw event, updating relative X and Y if the event is of type EV_REL.

methods.name: CursorMotionAccumulator::finishSync
methods.description: Resets relative axes after a sync event.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::CursorInputMapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the input mapper with device context and configuration.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::~CursorInputMapper
methods.description: Destructor that fades the pointer controller immediately if it exists.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::getSources
methods.description: Returns the input source type.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::populateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Populates device info with motion ranges based on current parameters and device bounds.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state and parameters of the cursor input mapper for debugging.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the input mapper based on new device configuration and changes.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::computeParameters
methods.description: Computes device parameters such as mode, orientation, and display association based on device context.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::dumpParameters
methods.description: Outputs the current parameters of the input mapper.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::reset
methods.description: Resets internal state, including button states, velocity controls, and accumulators.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::process
methods.description: Processes a raw event, updating accumulators and generating input notifications.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::sync
methods.description: Generates input notifications based on accumulated events and current device state.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::getScanCodeState
methods.description: Returns the state of a scan code if applicable.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::getAssociatedDisplayId
methods.description: Returns the associated display ID if available.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::configureBasicParams
methods.description: Configures basic parameters and device mode based on current device context.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::configureOnPointerCapture
methods.description: Configures device mode based on pointer capture request.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::configureOnChangePointerSpeed
methods.description: Adjusts velocity control parameters based on device configuration.

methods.name: CursorInputMapper::configureOnChangeDisplayInfo
methods.description: Updates display ID and orientation based on device viewport and configuration.
